Flexible floor plans: Five single-family floor plans from 1,290 to 2,180 square feet, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 2 to 3 bathrooms and 2-car garages. Built-in style: Every home at Shell Creek Manor features an open-concept layout with stylish features like quartz countertops and luxury vinyl-plank flooring. Convenient location: Shell Creek Manor offers easy access to Interstate 26 and boasts efficient commutes to Spartanburg, Greenville, and Columbia. articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and U.S. News World Report's Best Companies to Work For—today announced that, as part of its long-term succession planning process, Jim Francescon has been promoted to President, effective January 1, 2027. Mr. Francescon currently serves as Executive Vice President, Corporate Operations. Dale Francescon will continue to serve as Executive Chairman and Rob Francescon, who currently serves as Chief Executive Officer and President, will continue to serve as Chief Executive Officer. As President, Mr. Francescon will oversee the Company's homebuilding operations, land, and related corporate functions and will help drive the Company's strategy and growth.
